svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 1200 long (the deck width) from 50 x 50 x 3 tube;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square the ends and cap them with 3 mm plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 13 mm through both walls, 40 from each end, on the centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: these line up with the trailer's two side rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the skids run across the deck, 500 apart (centres), each 100 in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the ends of the firebox. Weld each to the firebox floor with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 mm stitch welds every 150, both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each end is held to the side rail by one M12 bolt through the skid,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the deck and the rail, nyloc nut under the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The skids hold the firebox floor 50 above the deck: an air gap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that keeps the deck cool. Never fill it in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both skids flat on a level floor; no rock.
